runner.unchanged: Only product hash pins, arm/suite labels and descriptions changed. Controller, pacing, preflight, parser, metrics and cleanup preserved.

conditions.display_rule: These are this fixed fixture's required observed extents, not a product-wide notch assumption. If display/surface differs, stop and report instead of silently changing resolution.
conditions.environment_rule: Preserve production flags and nineteen libraries in both arms, normalize only per-arm private paths. All traces/probes/validation/capture off in clean. Actual child and effective runtime settings must match staged receipts.
conditions.host: AC power, normal power mode, no concurrent build/game/capture/background test. Existing preflight checks, fullscreen ownership and sole-executor isolation remain in force; do not change security/power settings.

timing_and_analysis.warmup: Existing pacing unchanged; at least10 seconds wall warmup and ten nominal combat simulation seconds240..540. Record actual warmup/loading separately; do not promise total process time is exactly50s.
timing_and_analysis.metadata_correction: Historical LAUNCH planned600..1800 is stale. All real accepted G01 samples and controller use540..1740. New records must use observed540..1740 and retain full raw samples.
timing_and_analysis.metric: CPU-observed DrawScreen frames divided by measured wall seconds. 1% low and slow-frame counts are supporting metrics, not GPU/present FPS.
timing_and_analysis.retain: Keep every valid slow run. Report each run and arithmetic mean of three runs per arm; no historical pooling, trimming or unchanged retries.
timing_and_analysis.world_validation: Compare all40 unit/camera/speed/pause/simulation rows plus seeds, initial units, command and created/destroyed counts. A fixed seed alone does not prove identical rendering work.
timing_and_analysis.image_validation: Use existing post-count screenshot procedure. Inspect fixed geometry, stencil-dependent lines and omissions; document natural animated water/cloud/particle differences rather than treating them as automatic parity failures.

review.verified: Read DONE, source/toolchain/archive closure evidence, CANDIDATE, products, runner diff/AST review, staging summary and all seven LAUNCH records at fixed artifact commit. No new local execution or filesystem inspection performed by JINI.

gates: Read latest STATE; require HQ owner and exact round/source/input manifest. Verify all local runner, binary, nineteen library, LAUNCH and fresh fixture hashes before starting. Verify no consumed launch/receipt: ambiguity => BLOCKED, never restage or overwrite.
Reserve new attempt by CAS before first launch. Run existing validation command exactly once.

Before clean command, inspect validation raw log, Metal enabled/no errors, image, actual sample count/display/extents/flags, positive S01/G01 witnesses, normal retirement and all cleanup. If failed or ambiguous, stop and report; no clean launch.
Only if validation passes, run existing clean command exactly once for six ordered arms A B B A A B. No source/runner edits or additional telemetry in counted windows.

Retain all valid slow runs. Compare all40 world/camera/speed/pause/simulation rows and settings. If unmatched, report invalid comparison rather than FPS regression/improvement. Diagnose from existing logs only; no re-run.
Return per-arm FPS/frame metrics, three-per-arm arithmetic means, relative difference, raw samples/world checks and post-count images. Validation timing excluded; historical results not pooled.
Finish GPU/owned PIDs/helpers/workers/awake keeper and evidence writes before same-round DONE. Failure is also DONE only with cleanup; uncertainty => retain owner HQ/BLOCKED.
additional_gates: Existing r03_validation01 and r03_clean01 are already staged. Do not --stage, restage, overwrite or reuse a consumed arm. No new source/build/helper/capture.
